native.summary: Pancreas: serous acini with basophilic bases and apical zymogen granules, centroacinar cells and intercalated ducts (no striated ducts), intralobular and interlobular ducts, and an islet of Langerhans with intermingled beta, alpha, delta and PP cells around a dense capillary network. A separate teaching set on the right repeats the islet and the exocrine units with space around them.
native.scale_note: Millimetres; both regions share one scale. Counts and spacing are chosen for teaching.

Whole model.note: Left: the pancreatic lobule cut by a front section. Right: the teaching set with space around each example.

Lobule.note: A pancreatic lobule: serous acini, the duct tree and an islet of Langerhans with its capillaries.

Islet in the lobule.note: The islet in its section: pale endocrine cells intermingled around capillaries, surrounded by darker acini.

Islets: surface, section, vascular windo.note: The same islet three ways: outer surface, cellular section, and a window cut to show its capillaries.

Exocrine units and ducts.note: Two acinar sections, an intact acinus and a branching tubuloacinar unit, each draining into one collecting duct tree.

viewer.scale_note: Millimetres; both regions share one scale. Counts and spacing are chosen for teaching.

parts.name: Lobule: Acinar cell nuclei
parts.description: Round basal nuclei of the pyramidal acinar cells.

parts.name: Lobule: Zymogen granules
parts.description: Eosinophilic zymogen granules (digestive proenzymes) crowded at the apex of each acinar cell, facing the tiny lumen.

parts.name: Lobule: Acinar cells: basal cytoplasm
parts.description: Basophilic basal cytoplasm of the acinar cells, rich in rough ER: the purple base of each serous cell.

parts.name: Lobule: Acinar cells: apical cytoplasm
parts.description: Paler apical cytoplasm holding the zymogen granules.

parts.name: Lobule: Centroacinar and duct cell nuclei
parts.description: Pale flattened nuclei of the centroacinar and intercalated duct cells.

parts.name: Lobule: Centroacinar cells
parts.description: Centroacinar cells: the start of the duct tucked inside the acinus, a hallmark of the pancreas. They secrete bicarbonate-rich fluid.

parts.name: Lobule: Intercalated ducts
parts.description: Short intercalated ducts lined by low cuboidal cells, leading out of each acinus. The pancreas has no striated ducts.

parts.name: Lobule: Tubuloacinar cell nuclei
parts.description: Nuclei of the branching tubuloacinar secretory unit.

parts.name: Lobule: Tubuloacinar zymogen granules
parts.description: Zymogen granules of the tubuloacinar unit.

parts.name: Lobule: Tubuloacinar cells: basal cytoplasm
parts.description: A branching tubuloacinar secretory unit: acini are often elongated and branched.

parts.name: Lobule: Tubuloacinar cells: apical cytoplasm
parts.description: Apical cytoplasm of the tubuloacinar cells.

parts.name: Lobule: Interlobular duct
parts.description: Interlobular duct in the connective tissue septum, lined by taller cuboidal to columnar cells.

parts.name: Lobule: Duct epithelial nuclei
parts.description: Nuclei of the collecting duct epithelium.

parts.name: Lobule: Intralobular ducts
parts.description: Intralobular ducts collecting from the intercalated ducts within the lobule.

parts.name: Lobule: Intercalated duct branches
parts.description: Branches joining the intercalated ducts to the intralobular ducts.

parts.name: Lobule: Beta cells (insulin)
parts.description: Beta cells: the most numerous islet cells, secreting insulin. In human islets they are intermingled with the other cell types.

parts.name: Lobule: Alpha cells (glucagon)
parts.description: Alpha cells secreting glucagon, scattered among the beta cells and along the capillaries in human islets.

parts.name: Lobule: Delta cells (somatostatin)
parts.description: Delta cells secreting somatostatin.

parts.name: Lobule: PP cells (pancreatic polypeptide)
parts.description: PP cells secreting pancreatic polypeptide (a few, representative).

parts.name: Lobule: Islet cell nuclei
parts.description: Nuclei of the islet cells.

parts.name: Lobule: Islet capillaries
parts.description: Dense fenestrated capillary network threading the islet; colour grades from arterial red to venous blue along the flow.

parts.name: Lobule: Arteriole
parts.description: Arteriole supplying the islet and lobule.

parts.name: Lobule: Venule
parts.description: Venule draining the lobule.

parts.name: Lobule: Insulo-acinar capillaries
parts.description: Capillaries leaving the islet to run among the acini (the insulo-acinar portal route), graded red to blue.

parts.name: Lobule: Connective tissue septa
parts.description: Thin connective tissue septa dividing the gland into lobules and carrying ducts and vessels; the pancreas has only a thin capsule.

parts.name: Lobule: Fibroblast nuclei
parts.description: Nuclei of fibroblasts in the septa.
